main_text.p: MATRIMONIO CVM MARIA, POTENTISSIMI Burgundionum Ducis Caroli filia, contracto: opulentissimae Belgarum Sequanorumque ditiones Austriacae domui adjectæ.
FVSO AD GVYNEGATAM VICVM Gallorum, qui ex triginta millibus hominum constabat, exercitu;magna pars Hannoniae una cum Imperiali urbe Cameraco recepta.
ATREBATVM ARTESIÆ METROPO-lis,quæ antea Gallorum armis cesserat,egregio stratagemate per nocturnas insidias deceptis hostium custodiis in potestatem redacta.

page.notes: Orange stains lie over "filia" in the first paragraph and over "Sequanorum" in the same paragraph; they are not printed text. The catchword at the foot is read as "Electo-" with a doubtful initial letter. Printing errors left as printed: "exercitu;magna" and "lis,quæ" and "cesserat,egregio" run together without spaces. The Greek-free page has no Greek or Hebrew.
